messages:
alex.sales: Quick question from Acme Health POC — they want SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, group->role RBAC, and domain claim verification before users can sign up. Also asking if SSO/SCIM affects hosted pricing or requires Dedicated.

mike.eng: We support SAML SP and IdP-initiated flows, assertion signing, and optional encryption. Group-based role mapping is supported via SCIM groups + mapping rules in Console.

sarah.se: For SCIM, we implement SCIM 2.0 delta sync and full sync. We also support custom attributes for department/entitlements. Bulk provisioning in first run can be heavy — recommend a staging sync window.

toni.prod: @alex.sales customer wants to know domain ownership verification method. Is DNS TXT enough or do we require certificate upload for enterprise?

mike.eng: Domain verification is DNS TXT or CNAME for the hosted Console. For Private/Dedicated, we can do a TLS cert upload if they want custom SSO endpoints. DNS TXT is usual and fastest.

emma.sec: Security notes: we need to clarify SAML metadata rotation (we support metadata URL + manual cert rotation), audit log retention options, and SCIM auth via bearer token with scoped scopes. Also confirm we can disable SCIM write for a subset of groups.

alex.sales: Pricing question: will enabling SSO/SCIM push them to a Dedicated plan? They cited HIPAA-ish needs and want predictable throughput during initial sync.

mike.eng: Functional answer: SSO/SCIM itself is supported on Hosted. For very large provisioning bursts or guaranteed SLAs (and network isolation), recommend Dedicated. If they expect a one-time 50k user import, we can do it on Hosted but may need a short reservation or throttled sync.

alex.sales: Customer follow-up: can Redwood do a one-off data ingestion for the POC (50k users, groups) without Dedicated? They prefer not to commit.

sarah.se: We offered a staged approach: 1) run delta SCIM in their IdP for a week against staging; 2) do controlled full import during off-hours with rate limits; 3) monitor token and mem usage. For the POC we can waive a short burst fee if they sign an MSA addendum.

toni.prod: Timeline: Acme wants POC in 3 weeks. Need test IdP metadata, SCIM token, sample group-role mapping config, and a list of test user emails+domains.

alex.sales: I'll get their test metadata today. Any blockers from sec/legal?

emma.sec: Send over their completed security questionnaire (we flagged audit retention, MFA enforcement for admin users, and key rotation cadence). Also need their reqs for breach notification timelines.

okta-bot: (automated) Reminder: SAML metadata upload succeeded for acme-health-staging.

mike.eng: SCIM endpoints for the POC (staging):
```
POST https://staging-api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users
GET  https://staging-api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Groups
Authorization: Bearer <scim-token>
```
Include Accept: application/scim+json. For large imports, use chunked calls and the bulk endpoint.

alex.sales: Awesome — I'll confirm the MSA addendum language and schedule the off-hours import. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

sarah.se: FYI to docs: we should add a short checklist for SCIM full-import best practices (timeouts, chunk sizes, retry policy).

toni.prod: Noted. I'll create a POC runbook and link it in the ticket.

alex.sales: End of thread — will post results after the POC run.
